about.title: Mill Valley Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Mill Valley is a small place, roughly 14,000 people tucked between the redwoods and Richardson Bay, and a death here is felt on every block. Public records for the most recent final crash year show 43 injury collisions and 60 people hurt in town, with no traffic deaths recorded that year. That is worth being grateful for. Still, wrongful death claims arise from far more than traffic: a fall at a rental property, a missed diagnosis, neglect in a care facility, a defective product, or a collision on US-101, Miller Avenue, Camino Alto or E Blithedale Avenue, the corridors that account for most of the town's reported crashes. Under California law, a spouse or domestic partner and children stand first in line to bring a claim, followed by certain dependents and heirs. The deadline is generally two years from the date of death, and shorter when a public agency is involved. LawProactive is not a law firm. We simply match you with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless something is recovered.

whyChoose.title: How LawProactive Helps Mill Valley Families

items.title: Standing sorted out early
items.desc: California limits who may file: a spouse or domestic partner and children come first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can confirm who in your family is eligible before anything is filed.

items.title: Deadlines handled with care
items.desc: The general limit is two years from the date of death, but claims against a city, county or state agency carry a much shorter notice window. Getting connected early keeps those options open.

items.title: Losses measured fully, not narrowly
items.desc: Recoverable damages include funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance. Your attorney works on contingency, so nothing is owed unless there is a recovery.

items.question: Mill Valley had no traffic deaths last year. Does that mean wrongful death cases are rare here?
items.answer: Traffic deaths are only one category. Wrongful death claims in Marin County also arise from medical negligence, care-facility neglect, unsafe premises and defective products, none of which appear in crash statistics. If a family member died because someone else acted carelessly, the type of incident does not change your right to ask questions.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim the same as the criminal case?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death lawsuit is a civil action brought by the family, separate from any charges the Marin County District Attorney may pursue. The two can proceed at the same time, and a civil claim can move forward even if no criminal charges are ever filed.

items.question: What does it cost to use LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. We are a free connection service, not a law firm, and we match you with an independent attorney who accepts wrongful death cases on a contingency basis. You pay no legal fee unless there is a recovery, and the first conversation carries no obligation.
